subject: Data sovereignty offboarding: custody transfer & closure checklist
messages:
From: Anne Brooks <anne.brooks@finserv.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: compliance+retentions@finserv.com
Date: 2026-11-15 13:12 UTC
Subject: Data offboarding request — prompts, outputs, runtime logs

Hi Olga,

We're initiating a formal offboarding for a FinServ EU tenancy (Acct: FinServ Solutions, EU-prod-3). We need Redwood to:

- Remove all user-provided prompts and model outputs associated with the tenancy (including transient caches and derived artifacts).
- Provide a verifiable log-handback that shows deletion operations for runtime logs, access traces, and any retained KV/ephemeral caches.
- Deliver a signed attestation and a manifest we can attach to an audit filing.

Target timeline: completion and artifacts by EOD 2026-11-18. Please confirm scope, expected deliverables, and where we should expect proofs (Drive link / DocuSign).

Legal will follow up with any POAR if needed.

Thanks,
Anne Brooks
Director, Data Governance
FinServ Solutions
[Attachment: retention-request-form.pdf (stub)]
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Anne Brooks <anne.brooks@finserv.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-15 15:04 UTC
Subject: Re: Data offboarding request — prompts, outputs, runtime logs

Hi Anne — thanks for the clear ask. Confirming receipt and scope. Summary of our plan below:

1) Scope: all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and any derived artifacts (prefix cache, KV entries, temporary kernel traces) for tenancy EU-prod-3.
2) Execution window: 2026-11-17 02:00–05:00 UTC (low-traffic maintenance window) — rollback guarded by canary checks.
3) Evidence: a CSV manifest of deleted keys + SHA256 checksums for stored snapshots, plus a signed attestation PDF.
4) Logs: we will redact operational PII, produce an access-trace report, and include a chain-of-custody entry for any exported artifacts.

Attachments: redwood-offboarding-manifest.csv (stub) — this will be updated after sweep.

Action items:
- Marissa: lead ops execution and provide runbook.
- Rishi: verify KVstore snapshot generation and provide checksum file.
- Anne: confirm DocuSign recipient for the attestation packet (legal@finserv.com ok?).

I'll post Drive links to the artifacts when complete.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Signature block]
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-16 08:30 UTC
Subject: RE: Data offboarding request — prompts, outputs, runtime logs

Quick tech notes (cc Anne after we finalize):

- KVstore: we'll perform an export of keys scoped to tenant EU-prod-3, calculate SHA256 checksums, then issue an irreversible delete on the primary and replica shards. Snapshot files will be time-stamped and included in the manifest.
- Runtime logs: segregate by retention tag, redact end-user identifiers, then delete raw event logs older than the retention cutoff and mark corresponding index entries as purged.
- Caches: prefix/KV caches will be flushed and cache segments reclaimed. There may be short-lived cache artifacts that require two passes to ensure eviction; we'll run verification jobs 24 and 72 hours post-sweep.

Estimated completion for artifact generation: 2026-11-18 12:00 UTC.

Files I will drop into the artifact folder: kvstore-snapshot-checksum.txt, offboard-runbook.md (internal).

-Rishi
From: legal@finserv.com
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: anne.brooks@finserv.com
Date: 2026-11-16 10:45 UTC
Subject: RE: Data offboarding request — prompts, outputs, runtime logs

Olga — Legal here. We need the final attestation to be executed via DocuSign and include:

- Statement of scope (tenant ID and data classes removed).
- Date/time of final deletion actions (UTC).
- Name and title of Redwood signatory and an audit trail for the attestation signature.
- A manifest listing deleted artifacts (CSV) plus checksums.

Please confirm DocuSign packet and recipient (legal@finserv.com). Also confirm whether the chain-of-custody entries will include operator IDs.

Regards,
FinServ Legal
From: olga.petrov@redwood.com
To: Anne Brooks <anne.brooks@finserv.com>, legal@finserv.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18 16:05 UTC
Subject: Re: Data offboarding request — prompts, outputs, runtime logs — final confirmation

Anne / Legal — final delivery below. Thank you for the turnaround.

Summary of completed actions (EU-prod-3):
- Prompt inputs and generated outputs: full sweep executed 2026-11-17 02:18–03:42 UTC; ephemeral caches flushed; two-pass verification completed 2026-11-18 02:18 UTC.
- KVstore snapshots: exported and checksummed; irreversible deletes executed on primary/replica 2026-11-17 03:05 UTC.
- Runtime logs/access traces: redaction applied where required; raw event logs removed and indexes marked purged 2026-11-17 04:10 UTC.

Delivered artifacts (links & attachments):
- Manifest: redwood-offboarding-manifest.csv [Attachment stub]
- Checksums: kvstore-snapshot-checksum.txt [Attachment stub]
- Signed attestation: attestation-signed.pdf (DocuSign packet complete; envelope ID: ABC-12345)
- Evidence folder (read-only): https://drive.redwood.internal/finserv/offboarding/manifest-20261118

Chain-of-custody: operator IDs and runbook steps recorded in the manifest (column: operator_id). If you need a redacted public view for auditors, we can provide a copy that omits operator IDs and internal ticket refs.

Next steps:
- Legal to confirm receipt of DocuSign packet and close the audit ticket.
- Anne to confirm that the artifacts satisfy the record for your audit.

If there are any residual requests (POAR / regulatory hold exceptions), flag them and we'll pause further action and provide a preservation report.

—Olga Petrov
Head of Compliance Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: attestation-signed.pdf (stub), redwood-offboarding-manifest.csv (stub), kvstore-snapshot-checksum.txt (stub)]
